title: System
usersDescription: Create and maintain back-office users, account status, roles, Google 2FA, login allowlists, and permitted login times.

errors.adminSelfDemotionDenied: You cannot remove your own super administrator role.
errors.adminSelfDisableDenied: You cannot disable the currently signed-in account.
errors.adminSelfRoleChangeDenied: You cannot change the role of your own account.
errors.adminSelfStatusChangeDenied: You cannot change the status of your own account.
errors.superRoleAssignmentDenied: The super administrator role cannot be assigned to a new user.
errors.builtInAdminIdentityProtected: The built-in administrator identity cannot be changed.
errors.builtInAdminRoleProtected: The fixed role of a built-in administrator cannot be changed.
errors.defaultMenuProtected: The default workspace menu cannot be modified.
errors.menuCycle: The menu hierarchy cannot contain a cycle.
errors.menuHasChildren: Delete or move the child menus first.
errors.menuReorderIncomplete: Submit the complete menu tree when reordering.
errors.permissionCycle: The permission hierarchy cannot contain a cycle.
errors.permissionHasChildren: Delete or move the child permissions first.
errors.permissionInUse: This permission is assigned to a role and cannot be deleted.
errors.permissionReorderIncomplete: Submit the complete permission tree when reordering.
errors.protectedAdminUserDeleteDenied: Administrator and super administrator accounts cannot be deleted.
errors.roleInUse: This role is assigned to a user and cannot be deleted.
errors.superAdminRequired: Only a super administrator can modify the manager role.
errors.systemMenuProtected: System menus cannot be modified or deleted.
errors.systemPermissionProtected: System permissions cannot be modified or deleted.
errors.systemRoleIdentityProtected: The fixed manager role identity cannot be changed.
errors.systemRoleProtected: System roles cannot be modified or deleted.
errors.usernameImmutable: A username cannot be changed after the user is created.

fields.name: Name
fields.newPassword: New Password (leave blank to keep it)

messages.required: Complete the username, name, and password fields.

placeholders.allowlist:
Adding entries enables the allowlist; leave blank to disable it. One entry per line, for example:
203.0.113.10
10.0.0.0/24
2001:db8::/32

tips.allowlist: Outside the local environment, the current IP must match a configured allowlist entry to sign in.

password.strong: Strong passwords require at least 12 characters with uppercase letters, lowercase letters, and numbers.
password.weak: Weak passwords require at least 6 characters with no character-combination requirement.

tips.twoFactor: After the allowlist check passes, the user binds or verifies Google Authenticator on the login page.

rolesDescription: Create and maintain roles, then assign menus and operation permissions.

messages.required: Enter the role code and name.

permissionsDescription: Maintain permission hierarchy, server-side codes, and related menus.

messages.codeInvalid: Use a dot-separated permission code starting with a lowercase letter, for example match.publish.
messages.required: Enter the permission code and name.
messages.sortFailed: Permission reordering failed and the previous order was restored.

placeholders.name: Enter a permission name or locale key

menusDescription: Maintain menu hierarchy, routes, icons, ordering, and access permissions.

help.routePath: The frontend route for the administration page, for example /system/users; this is not a backend API path.

messages.required: Complete the menu title, icon, and menu type.
messages.sortFailed: Menu reordering failed and the previous order was restored.

placeholders.title: Enter a menu title or locale key

loginLogsDescription: Review login results, access devices, user agents, IP addresses, and login times for back-office users.
auditLogsDescription: Review create, update, delete, and other data operations performed by back-office users.

placeholders.actionType: Select or search for an action type
placeholders.businessAction: Select or search for a business action

settingsDescription: Manage the system name, default page size, and login-page settings in one place.

systemName.description: The system name displayed in the upper-left corner of the administration panel.
systemName.label: System name

pageSize.description: Set the default number of records displayed per page, from 10 to 100.
pageSize.label: Default page size

passwordStrength.description: Control the password rule used when creating users, resetting passwords, changing a personal password, and creating administrators from the command line. Changes affect only passwords set afterward.
passwordStrength.label: Password type

loginRememberMe.description: Control whether the Remember Me option is displayed on the administration login page.
loginRememberMe.label: Show Remember Me

loginDescription.description: Set the description shown in the login promotion area for every language.
loginDescription.label: Login description

loginTheme.description: Set the login page color theme globally. The login page no longer exposes a temporary switcher.
loginTheme.label: Login page theme

loginLayout.description: Place the login form on the left, center, or right for every visitor.
loginLayout.label: Login page layout

messages.invalid: The system settings are invalid. Check them and try again.
messages.loginDescriptionInvalid: The login description must be text with no more than 500 characters.
messages.loginRememberMeInvalid: The Show Remember Me setting is invalid.
messages.pageSizeInvalid: The default page size must be an integer from 10 to 100.
messages.passwordStrengthInvalid: The password type must be weak or strong.
messages.systemNameInvalid: The system name must be text with no more than 500 characters.
